changelog: Seamless Video Progress: Your playback automatically saves and syncs across different video sources.
Real-Time Host Activity: See what movie or show the host is browsing in real time.
Smarter Watch Parties: Enjoy seamless reconnections and bulletproof party stability.
Polished UI & Animations: Fresh new animations for Watch Party buttons, banners, and member tags.

features.title: What's New
items: Live Host Activity Banner: See what title the host is currently browsing or checking out before playing.
Watch Party History: Movies watched together are now automatically saved to your personal viewing history.
Visual Progress Bars: Track your watched progress directly on your media cards at a glance.

features.title: Better Experience
items: Universal Progress Syncing: Seamless watch progress tracking across all streaming servers.
Redesigned Watch Party Buttons: Smoother animations, clear state transitions, and sleeker dropdowns.
Enhanced Member Details: Added improved profile badges and tooltips to see who added each title.

features.title: Bug Fixes
items: Watch Party Reconnections: Fixed room disconnections and host transfer edge cases for a rock-solid experience.
Instant Data Refresh: Fixed background sync so your lists and details update immediately when you navigate.
